title: A Video Call With My Sister About Getting Promoted
script: Umar: [excited] Laila, guess what? I got the promotion! I'm officially the team lead starting next month.
Laila: [warmly] Umar, that's incredible! You worked so hard for this. I'm so proud of you.
Umar: Thank you! Honestly, I still can't quite believe it. I keep checking the email again and again.
Laila: You deserve it completely. But can I say something, as your slightly annoying older sister?
Umar: Of course, you always say something anyway, whether I ask or not.
Laila: Just remember, when you start leading people, some of them are older than you or more experienced.
Umar: I know. Honestly, that part already makes me a little nervous.
Laila: [nervous] Good nervousness, I think. It means you're taking it seriously instead of assuming you already know everything.
Umar: Do you remember when you became supervisor at your job? How did you handle that at first?
Laila: I made mistakes early on. I talked too much and listened too little, and people definitely noticed.
Umar: Really? You seem so naturally good with people now, so easy to talk to.
Laila: It took real time. One coworker eventually told me honestly that I sounded arrogant sometimes, even without meaning to.
Umar: [reflective] That must have been hard to hear from someone you worked with every day.
Laila: It was, but it helped me more than any compliment ever could. I started asking questions instead of just giving instructions.
Umar: So your advice is, ask more, and assume less about what people already understand?
Laila: Exactly. And never let a new title make you forget the people who helped you get there.
Umar: You helped me get here too, you know. You always believed I could actually do this.
Laila: That means a lot, Umar. Just promise me you'll stay the same kind person, even with the new title.
Umar: [sincerely] I promise. Success like this is a test as much as a reward, isn't it, really?
Laila: [encouraging] Exactly right. And I truly think you're going to pass that test.

quiz.question: What news does Umar share with his sister?
options: He got promoted to team lead
quiz.explanation: Umar tells Laila he got the promotion and is officially team lead starting next month.

quiz.question: What does Laila warn Umar about as he starts leading people?
options: Some of his team will be older or more experienced than him
He will have to work weekends
quiz.explanation: Laila reminds him some people he leads will be older or more experienced than him.

quiz.question: What mistake did Laila make early in her own leadership role?
options: She talked too much and listened too little
quiz.explanation: Laila admits she talked too much and listened too little when she first became supervisor.

quiz.question: What did a coworker once tell Laila?
quiz.explanation: A coworker honestly told her she sometimes sounded arrogant, even without meaning to.

quiz.question: What does Laila make Umar promise?
options: To stay the same kind person even with his new title
To give her a job on his team
quiz.explanation: Laila asks Umar to promise he'll stay the same kind person, even with the new title.

quiz.question: Why is Umar nervous about the new role?
options: He does not know his job title
His sister works on the team
Some team members have more experience
quiz.explanation: Leading older or more experienced people feels challenging to him.

quiz.question: What does “arrogant” mean in this conversation?
options: Acting as if you know more than others
quiz.explanation: Laila sounded too sure of herself and did not listen enough.

quiz.question: How did Laila improve as a supervisor?
quiz.explanation: She learned to listen instead of speaking all the time.

quiz.question: Why does Laila call Umar’s nervousness good?
options: It shows he takes the role seriously
It will make him leave the job
It proves the team is difficult
It means he needs another email
quiz.explanation: His concern shows that he does not think he already knows everything.

quiz.question: What should Umar remember after the promotion?
quiz.explanation: Laila asks him to remain kind and remember other people’s support.
